Title: Superior Rockheart, how much does it prevent?

Messages.Author: Miasmat
Messages.Body:
says you prevent half (rounded up).  says "As above, and prevent half... (rounded up)". So, if my poor gargoyle gets hit for 3, does a single superior Rockheart prevent ALL the damage? I guess it comes down to, does "for the remainder of combat" include this strike that I'm preventing damage from right now? Is  kind of like playing basic  twice?

> Rockheart
> Combat
> Strike: dodge.
> Prevent half the damage (round up) done by the opponent's strike. (Doing this twice would prevent all damage from the strike.)
> As above, and prevent half the damage (round up) done by each strike of the opponent for the remainder of combat. A vampire may play only one Rockheart at superior each combat.
>
Thanks

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
Unfortunately, LSJ only addressed Rockheart in 1 thread on the newsgroup, here:

LSJ July 7, 2010

I would say no, it is not like playing basic twice.

> Card wrote:
> by each strike of the opponent for the remainder of combat.
>
The extra prevent should not include the strike which has already resolved.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Adonai wrote:
> Unfortunately, LSJ only addressed Rockheart in 1 thread on the newsgroup, here:
>
> LSJ July 7, 2010
>
> I would say no, it is not like playing basic twice.
>
Correct.
If you get punched for 3 and play superior Rockheart, you prevent 2 (and will prevent half of each opponent's strike for the remainder of combat).
